contract.intended_consumer: Brian and coding agents starting consequential Agentic Engineering work
contract.outcome: A selected repository rejects a structurally incomplete new plan before coordination mutation and admits an exact declared-structure plan with an inspectable epistemic frontier, reassessment contract, and explicit coverage non-claim.

canonical_journey.starting_state: The plan validator reports outcome, behavioral example, critical-path class, and capability adoption as nonblocking warnings, while plan-start readiness checks only graph state.
canonical_journey.input: One configured incomplete Plan 125-or-newer fixture and one complete Planning Integrity 1.0.0 plan with an exploration row.
canonical_journey.action: Run the shared plan validator and sanctioned plan-start boundary against both exact plans before any claim, branch, worktree, or tracker mutation.
canonical_journey.observable_result: The incomplete plan returns a typed fail with no coordination mutation; the complete declared structure returns a digest-bound pass, retains its frontier and reassessment fields, and states that omitted material areas or optimality are not mechanically proven.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: Missing or malformed semantic fields pass, structural PASS is presented as proof of material completeness or optimality, checker errors appear compliant, stale plan bytes reuse a receipt, installed templates omit the gate, compatibility work breaks historical plans or unplanned-light work, or a duplicate planning/runtime owner is introduced.
